description: This Java class 'DefaultStatsFactory' implements the 'StatsFactory' interface, providing methods to create and manage various metrics counters, gauges, and timers using the Micrometer library within the Thingsboard project. It handles metrics configuration, initialization, and provides utility methods for metric creation and tagging.

classes.name: DefaultStatsFactory
classes.description: Implementation of StatsFactory for creating and managing metrics counters, gauges, and timers using Micrometer.

classes.name: StubCounter
classes.description: A stub implementation of the Counter interface that performs no operations, used as a placeholder when metrics are disabled.

methods.description: Initializes timerPercentiles array from configuration string.
